card.name: Start of a new label section heading
card.fires_on: The first piece of a new section or subsection heading in drug labels, right after the previous paragraph ends or at a section number. Often the word Use after Concomitant, or the number or first syllable of a heading.

modes.label: Heading word after Concomitant
modes.description: The word Use in a heading like Concomitant Use with a drug class.
modes.example: Concomitant<< Use>> with Neuromuscular Blocking Agents Lith

modes.label: First piece of a new heading
modes.description: The opening syllable of a warning heading that starts right after a sentence ends, with no line break.

modes.label: Section number
modes.description: A period or digit in a section number such as 5.2 or 8. before a heading.

card.writes: It adds a push toward a topic-style heading phrase, such as 'the issue of' or 'the matter of', in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a new titled section begins in a drug label.
